name: GitHub stale CI cleanup
description: Warn and close abandoned pull requests whose required CI remains failing.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A(["Scheduled scan"]) --> B["PRs failing required CI 7 days"]
  B --> C["Post one warning"]
  C --> D{{"7 more days, no reply?"}}
  D -->|yes| E["Close the PR"]
  D -.->|"no, keep open"| A
exampleImplementation: A deterministic scheduled scan reads the required checks that apply to each pull request's base branch. It warns seven days after the newest required-check failure and closes seven days later only when the author has neither pushed nor commented.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to reconcile failing pull requests.

repositories.label: Repositories
repositories.help: Repositories whose open pull requests should be maintained.

githubTokenSecret.label: GitHub token secret
githubTokenSecret.help: Name of a saved GitHub token with rules and CI read access plus issue and pull-request write access. On OpenHands Cloud and Enterprise, leave the default when GitHub is connected: if this secret is not set, the token from your GitHub sign-in or Settings > Integrations is used. On a local Agent Canvas this secret is required.

setup.message: Configure the repositories, credential name, and schedule.
